# PRD-NNN: <Title>

## 1. Problem
Who has the problem, what it costs them, and the evidence for it.

## 2. Goals and non-goals
- Goal: measurable outcome.
- Non-goal: what this PRD deliberately excludes.

## 3. Users and journeys
One line per journey.

## 4. Functional requirements
| ID | Requirement | Acceptance criterion |
|---|---|---|
| FR-01 | ... | Binary, testable statement |

## 5. Constraints and business rules
Tenant isolation, quotas, language, providers. Link the ADR instead of restating a decision.

## 6. Open questions
Each names the owner decision needed or the ticket that resolves it.
